items.excerpt: Sudowrite adds Character Portraits to Story Bible: writers generate faces for character cards straight from the character's physical description in four preset styles (Painterly, Cinematic Realism, Bright Editorial, Storybook) or a custom style/reference image, saved to per-character galleries.
Sudowrite adds Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as selectable prose models across Write, Draft and Plugins for fiction authors.
Novelcrafter Live: testing the newest AI models to break writer's block, plus a walkthrough of Novelcrafter's new manuscript organisation options.

Apex CoVantage will launch eden, an AI copyediting engine for book and academic publishing, at Frankfurt Book Fair (Oct 7): subject-aware error detection, equation logic checks; copyeditors accept 80-90% of suggestions and passes run ~3x faster. Off-list domain: no on-list outlet had covered it.

Frankfurt 2026 must-see sessions: 'AI Narration Beyond the Lab' (Audatio, Blinkist, Storytel, Hörbuch Hamburg), AI & book publishing with Thad McIlroy, protecting content from AI text-and-data mining while using AI for discoverability (EDRLab).

Kenyan publishers report authors increasingly submitting AI-generated textbook content; houses are strengthening editorial checks and training editors to detect AI material. Off-list domain: textbook angle not covered on-list.
The architect of the UK creators' fightback that forced the government to drop free AI access to copyrighted books, songs and pictures warns Australia as it weighs a similar opt-out.

The EWC condemns AI firms' 'destructive scanning' of millions of old and rare European books for training and asks EU decision-makers to act. Off-list; overlaps the 09-26 book-scanning story, rank low.

Unsealed filings show OpenAI staff discussed training early GPT models on LibGen books, how to describe the source publicly, and the cost of buying books instead. Overlaps 09-22 unsealed-briefs card, rank low.
Because of widespread errors in Anthropic settlement claims, rights holders now get 60 days instead of 30 to submit supporting information in disputes.
Author Daisy Buchanan argues that handing even routine writing to AI robs writers of a life-enhancing skill.
A six-part model for explaining manuscript-submission spikes as agentic AI, zero-click discovery and AI tools reshape how authors find publishers.
